exposure: women who did not experience pregnancy after kidney transplantation
women who experienced pregnancy after kidney transplantation
cohort: 236 patients out of 3000 kidney transplant recipient who underwent renal transplantation (RT) at Mansoura Urology and Nephrology Centre between March 1976 and December 2019
finding: Although there was an increased rate of live births, pregnancy after kidney transplantation was associated with high risks of maternal and fetal complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (69.6%).
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was between 33 and 33.69 weeks.
